## Goal

Agents start from excellent templates, people see what Mostra can do, and the docs are built with Mostra itself.

Close each with the check below, through the real public interface (README §3).

| AU-06 | `mostra new` scaffolds from templates for each family (questionnaire, proposal, prototype or review, dashboard, deck, demo, inbox or actions, custom) with AGENTS.md included | I, R | `mostra new --template <family>` for every family produces an artifact that passes verify, with AGENTS.md (CI matrix); Mirza reviews |

## Scope

From [WORK_PACKAGES.md](../WORK_PACKAGES.md):

- `mostra new` templates for every family, one-off and long-lived (questionnaire, proposal, prototype or review, dashboard, deck, demo, inbox, tasks, custom), each with AGENTS.md, including a team (roster) form and a hosted-sharing example;
- the gallery (prompt, source and result side by side, including the launch demos);
- the docs site built with Mostra (generated references, per-page Markdown, `llms.txt`), deployed to GitHub Pages, covering remote servers, the relay, teams and the telemetry event list;
- an SPA first-class review across the codebase.

Design detail for this package:

- From WP-14 (D162): the Skill's three examples (`skills/mostra/assets/examples/`) seed the templates and the gallery; when `mostra new --template` exists, the Skill's step 2 and the scaffolded `AGENTS.md` (`packages/runtime/src/publish/scaffold.ts`) name it. Links from the Skill and the plugin's README to docs pages move to the docs site once it is deployed, and the plugin's `homepage` in `tools/plugins/definition.ts` with them.
- Templates per family, one-off and long-lived, each with AGENTS.md and passing verify; they include a team (roster) form and a hosted-sharing example (D121, D116).
- Gallery with prompt, source and result, including the launch demos.
- Docs site built with Mostra, generated references, per-page Markdown, `llms.txt`, deployed to GitHub Pages under `mostra-dev`; it covers remote servers, the relay, teams and the public telemetry event list (D119).
- SPA-mode completeness review (RS-02).

## Acceptance evidence

every template and example passes `verify` in CI with committed baselines; the docs site builds and deploys; Mirza's review of the gallery for "beautiful by default"; long-lived scenarios present in templates, conformance and gallery.

Also: `pnpm check` green, diff reviewed, the progress report's evidence table complete for every owned requirement (README §3), the evidence matrix regenerated, docs and AGENTS.md current, and the report finalized after acceptance (README §4).

## Risks and notes

- Every example is a CI test: keep baselines committed and stable.

## Handoff

v1 is feature-complete for the closeout.
